name: Lim-Dul
description: Necromancer whose consciousness persists in a ruby ring and possesses a new host.

description_citations.text: "The Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dul intercepts the Erne and raises undead legions from a frozen swamp.
timeline.quote: he raises his undead legions from a frozen swamp

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Frozen Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dul's zombies kill Sir Gregor while Onala is paralyzed by visions.
timeline.quote: Gregor is killed by the zombies

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Frozen Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac transforms Lim-Dul with the Master of the Hunt spell.
timeline.quote: Leshrac casts the Master of the Hunt spell on Lim-Dûl, transforming him into a mighty creature.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Frozen Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The knights defeat Lim-Dul with the Winds of Kataba and Word of Undoing; Leshrac leaves him in an Icy Prison.
timeline.quote: Leshrac is not pleased and leaves Lim-Dûl stuck in an Icy Prison

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Frozen Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Faralyn uses Rhuell's death energy to open the rift; Lim-Dul escapes and Leshrac kills Ravidel with Fire Covenant.
timeline.quote: Leshrac casts Fire Covenant , bringing fiery harm to all present and killing Ravidel.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaeuhl tosses the Amulet of Quoz and defeats Szat.
timeline.quote: the Amulet falls head's up and grants Jaeuhl victory. Szat is defeated.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat and Lim-Dul escape through a portal to Shandalar.
timeline.quote: a portal opens up to transport Szat and Lim-Dûl to Shandalar

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avram Garrison, aided by Lim-Dul, forms the Knights of Stromgald and attempts a coup, which fails; the Knights become zombified minions.
timeline.quote: The coup failed, and the Knights were turned into zombified minions of Lim-Dûl

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Darien takes firm control, unites the army under General Varchild and allies with the Balduvian barbarians against Lim-Dul.
timeline.quote: even made an alliance with the Balduvian barbarians

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the final battle against Lim-Dul, the alliance shatters and Varchild goes rogue against the Balduvians.
timeline.quote: After the final battle against Lim-Dûl, the alliance shattered

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat manipulates the battle between Freyalise and Jason Carthalion so that Storgard is damaged, and patronizes Lim-Dul with Leshrac.
timeline.quote: Szat and another evil planeswalker, Leshrac , acted as patrons to the necromancer Lim-Dûl during his war against Kjeldor .

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the last battle against Lim-Dul, Leshrac cuts off the necromancer's hand and the ruby ring holding Mairsil/Dul's mind seeks a new host.
timeline.quote: just after Leshrac has cut off the necromancer's hand

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twenty years later Jaya shows Jodah the blackened hand of Dul, claiming to have found it in a Soldev market.
timeline.quote: She shows him the blackened hand of Dûl which she claims to have found in a market in Soldev .

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Students at the School find a cloud of black mana in the basement; Gerda recalls Lim-Dul asking her to look after his bottomless pit.
timeline.quote: twenty years ago Lim-Dûl contacted her, offering to take Jodah off her hands

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Kjeld Jodah is attacked by a Phantasmal Fiend sent by Lim-Dul; Jaya falls ill.
timeline.quote: Then Jaya suddenly falls very ill.

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Beneath Soldev, Lim-Dul reveals himself as Jaya, stabs Jodah in the throat, and uses his blood to activate the War Beasts, which destroy Soldev.
timeline.quote: There Lim-Dûl reveals himself: all this time he had been Jaya!

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah chooses to save his friend over his school; he smashes the mirror into Jaya's face and she ascends as a planeswalker, purging Dul and Mairsil.
timeline.quote: she indeed ascends, purging Dûl and Mairsil from her mind
